channel.title: Engineering Reference on Industrial Manufacturing Knowledge Base
channel.description: Open industrial manufacturing knowledge base: aluminum & magnesium die casting, CNC machining, injection molding, tooling, materials, automotive manufacturing and supplier selection. 50+ engineering articles and reference tables.

item.title: Aluminum Die Casting Alloy Comparison: A380, ADC12, A383, A360, A413, A356
item.description: Compare A380, ADC12, A383, A360, A413 and A356 aluminum casting alloys on composition, tensile strength, density and castability to select the right alloy for die casting.

item.title: Automotive Die Casting Guide: Specifying Structural Castings
item.description: Guide to specifying automotive structural die castings: IATF 16949, APQP/PPAP, vacuum HPDC, elongation after T7, crash load paths and Al-on-steel corrosion isolation.

item.title: Casting Defect Catalog: Causes, Identification and Correction
item.description: Casting defect catalog for die casting: cold shut, misrun, porosity, hot tear, solder, flash, blister, warpage, inclusion and erosion with cause, identification and correction.

item.title: CNC Tolerance Chart: Capability by Process and Feature
item.description: CNC machining tolerance chart by process: ISO 2768-m/f, standard ±0.125 mm shop capability, ±0.025 precision, ±0.0125 tight, and hole grades H7/H8 by ream and bore.

item.title: DFM Checklist: Design for Manufacture of Cast and Machined Parts
item.description: Design for manufacture checklist for cast and machined aluminium parts: wall thickness, draft, fillets, hole depth limits, tolerances, setups and standard tools.

item.title: Die Casting Tolerance Guide: NADCA Standards and Practical Limits
item.description: Die casting tolerances per NADCA for aluminum, zinc and magnesium: linear, parting-line and moving-die limits, plus draft angles and wall-thickness practical guidance for drawings.

item.title: EV Battery Housing Manufacturing Guide
item.description: Manufacturing guide for EV battery enclosures: pack vs structural pack (CTP/CTB), IP67 seal, thermal-runaway barrier, HV isolation, extrusion plus HPDC nodes and cooling plate.

item.title: Material Selection Guide: Die Cast Alloy Decision Logic
item.description: Material selection logic for die cast parts: compare aluminum, magnesium, zinc and engineering plastics on strength, weight, wall thickness, corrosion, service temperature, cost and plating.

item.title: OEM Supplier Audit Checklist for Casting and Machined Parts
item.description: OEM supplier audit checklist for casting and machined-part suppliers: QSA vs QPA, IATF 16949, machine tonnage, in-house machining, SPC/CMM, 8D/CAPA and molten-metal safety.

item.title: Surface Finish Guide: Ra Values, Processes and Specification
item.description: Surface roughness Ra values by process for die cast and machined parts: as-cast, milled, turned, ground, polished, bead blast and coating build-up, with how to specify finish.
